cards.summary: 作者构建了 StableEval Arena，在隐藏的七天预测窗口内评估智能体诊断锚定压力和预测偏离一美元锚定的能力，使用交易所价量数据与市场背景特征进行防泄漏历史回放。实验包含 120 例压力富集验证块和 507 例自然分布全竞技场评估块，测试六种 LLM 智能体配置及基线。作者报告称，智能体能以适度成本稳定产生有效结构化输出，但仍漏报大多数罕见严重压力和持续脱锚情形，并据此认为可信度应同时包含预测质量、运行可靠性和计算成本。
cards.limitations: 结果基于作者设定的历史回放协议、特定数据集和六种 LLM 智能体配置，不能直接推广到实盘交易或其他资产类别。隐藏七天预测窗口和压力富集样本可能影响对真实分布下罕见事件的评估；基准衡量的是锚定风险预测，不构成投资建议或实盘可行性证明。
cards.description: 该工作提出 StableEval Arena，一个面向 LLM 智能体系统的成本感知基准，用于评估稳定币脱锚风险预测能力。其新意在于将预测质量、结构化输出可靠性和推理成本作为联合可信度指标，而非仅比较准确率，并通过防泄漏历史回放提供可复现的审计环境。
keyPointsEn: The benchmark uses leakage-safe historical replay with a hidden seven-day forecast horizon and two evaluation blocks: stress-enriched and natural-distribution.
Evaluation dimensions include forecast quality, calibrated-label behavior, structured-output reliability, latency, token consumption, and estimated inference cost.
Results show a gap between protocol-following reliability and financial-risk reliability: structured outputs are stable, but most rare severe-stress and sustained-depeg cases are missed.
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces StableEval Arena, a cost-aware benchmark for evaluating LLM-backed agentic systems on stablecoin depeg-risk prediction. Its novelty lies in treating forecast quality, structured-output reliability, and inference cost as joint trustworthiness metrics rather than ranking by accuracy alone, and in providing a leakage-safe historical replay environment for reproducible auditing.
keyPoints: 基准采用防泄漏历史回放和隐藏七天预测窗口，并使用压力富集与自然分布两个评估块。
评估维度涵盖预测质量、校准标签行为、结构化输出可靠性、延迟、token 消耗和估计推理成本。
结果显示协议遵循可靠性与金融风险可靠性之间存在明显差距：结构化输出稳定，但罕见严重压力与持续脱锚多数被漏报。
cards.titleEn: StableEval Arena: A Cost-Aware Agentic Benchmark for Stablecoin Price Stability Prediction
cards.originalTitle: StableEval Arena: A Cost-Aware Agentic Benchmark for Stablecoin Price Stability Prediction
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准将成本与运行可靠性纳入智能体可信度评估，有助于量化研究社区在稳定币风险场景中更全面地比较 LLM 智能体，而非仅依赖准确率。其公开数据集与代码也便于审计和复现。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark incorporates cost and operational reliability into agent trustworthiness evaluation, helping the quantitative research community compare LLM agents more comprehensively in stablecoin risk scenarios rather than relying on accuracy alone. Its public dataset and code also support auditing and replication.
cards.title: StableEval Arena：稳定币锚定风险预测的成本感知基准
cards.summaryEn: The authors build StableEval Arena to evaluate agents' ability to diagnose peg stress and forecast deviations from the one-dollar peg over a hidden seven-day horizon, using leakage-safe historical replay with exchange price-volume data and market-context features. Experiments include a 120-case stress-enriched validation block and a 507-case natural-distribution full-arena evaluation block, testing six LLM-backed agent configurations and baselines. The authors report that agents reliably produce valid structured outputs at modest measured cost but still miss most rare severe-stress and sustained-depeg cases, arguing that trustworthiness should combine forecast quality, operational reliability, and computational cost.
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on the authors' historical replay protocol, specific datasets, and six LLM-backed agent configurations, and do not directly generalize to live trading or other asset classes. The hidden seven-day forecast window and stress-enriched samples may affect evaluation of rare events under real-world distributions; the benchmark measures peg-risk prediction and does not constitute investment advice or proof of live-trading viability.

cards.summary: 文档将自动执行算法分为基于日程与寻求流动性两类，本文针对前者，指出 TWAP、VWAP、POV 与 Implementation Shortfall 均基于显式模型、预测、日程或控制规则。作者提出 Shadow-PPOV：在观察到第三方新增订单时，可能在同一价格同一场所发送自己的限价单，并记录该订单交易所标识与自身订单的单一关联；撤单由标识驱动，跟随订单取消时立即撤单，成交后经短暂宽限期撤单。作者将其定位为无模型的被动下单基准，用于对预测性下单模型评分；评估基于 CME ES 期货全年确定性回放模拟，报告滑点与延迟敏感性，并与激进等效 POV 比较。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自 CME ES 期货的确定性回放模拟，未涉及实盘交易、其他资产类别或不同市场结构；无模型不等于无信息，其表现依赖观察到的订单流质量与延迟条件；与激进等效 POV 的比较结果限于该回放环境；未提供实盘验证或跨市场泛化证据。
cards.description: 提出 Shadow-PPOV，一种被动 POV 执行算法，其下单率由观察到的订单流而非成交量决定，价格与场所直接读取自第三方订单，无需订单簿模型或成交预测；在 CME ES 全年回放中评估滑点与延迟敏感性，并作为被动下单的无模型基准，供预测模型评分。
keyPointsEn: Shadow-PPOV reads price and venue directly from observed third-party orders, without an order-book model or fill prediction.
Cancellation is identifier-driven: the shadow is withdrawn immediately when the followed order is cancelled and after a brief grace window when it trades.
Evaluated on a full calendar year of CME ES futures in a deterministic market-replay simulator, reporting slippage and latency sensitivity and comparing against the aggressive equivalent POV.
The algorithm and order-book simulator are implemented in the open-source kaspar-hft project.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces Shadow-PPOV, a passive POV execution algorithm whose order-placement rate is set from observed order flow rather than traded volume and whose price and venue are read directly from third-party orders, requiring no order-book model or fill prediction; evaluated on a full-year CME ES replay for slippage and latency sensitivity and proposed as a model-free benchmark for passive placement against which predictive models can be scored.
keyPoints: Shadow-PPOV 的下单价格与场所直接读取自观察到的第三方订单，不依赖订单簿模型或成交预测。
撤单由标识驱动：跟随订单取消时立即撤单，成交后经短暂宽限期撤单。
在 CME ES 期货全年确定性市场回放中评估滑点与延迟敏感性，并与激进等效 POV 比较。
算法与订单簿模拟器在开源项目 kaspar-hft 中实现。
cards.titleEn: Order-Level Shadowing Enables Model-Free Passive Execution
cards.originalTitle: Model-Free Passive Execution via Order-Level Shadowing
cards.whyItMatters: 为被动订单放置提供一个无模型基准，使预测性下单模型可在相同条件下评分，并帮助理解订单流信息继承与延迟敏感性的作用。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a model-free benchmark for passive-order placement, allowing predictive placement models to be scored under common conditions and helping clarify the roles of inherited order-flow information and latency sensitivity.
cards.title: 订单级影子跟踪实现无模型被动执行
cards.summaryEn: The source organizes automated execution algorithms into schedule-based and liquidity-seeking families and notes that schedule-based members, including TWAP, VWAP, POV, and Implementation Shortfall, are model-based because each derives decisions from an explicit model, forecast, schedule, or control rule. The author introduces Shadow-PPOV: upon observing a third-party add, it may transmit its own limit order at the same price on the same venue and records a single association between the observed order's exchange identifier and its own; cancellation is identifier-driven, withdrawing the shadow when the followed order ends, immediately on a cancel and after a brief grace window on a trade. The work proposes it as a model-free benchmark for passive-order placement against which a predictive placement model can be scored, with evaluation on a full calendar year of replayed CME ES futures in a deterministic market-replay simulator, reporting slippage and latency sensitivity and comparing it against the aggressive equivalent POV.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from deterministic replay simulation of CME ES futures, with no live trading, other asset classes, or different market structures; model-free is not information-free, and performance depends on the quality of observed order flow and latency conditions; comparison against the aggressive equivalent POV is limited to that replay setting; no live validation or cross-market generalization evidence is provided.

cards.summary: 文章提出CDNOTS，一种面向非平稳时间序列的因果结构学习算法，在CD-NOD基础上专门处理时间序列的滞后依赖。作者对比不同条件独立性检验和显著性水平等算法选择，为样本量、问题维度和计算资源提供超参数建议。基于模拟结果，将CDNOTS应用于金融场景，识别非平稳时间序列间的因果联系。
cards.limitations: 证据主要基于作者使用的模拟数据和特定金融应用，未说明所有数据场景下的普适性；算法性能依赖条件独立性检验和显著性水平等超参数选择；因果结论的稳健性需独立数据与外部验证。
cards.description: 提出CDNOTS方法，针对非平稳时间序列的滞后依赖改进CD-NOD算法，并通过模拟与金融实证展示其在因子投资、组合分散和市场动态理解中的应用潜力。
keyPointsEn: CDNOTS is a refined version of CD-NOD designed to account for lagged dependencies in time series data.
The study compares algorithmic choices including the type of conditional independence test and the significance level, and provides hyperparameter selection guidance.
Building on simulated data, the method is applied to financial applications such as factor-based investing, portfolio diversification, and understanding market dynamics.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces CDNOTS, which refines CD-NOD for lagged dependencies in nonstationary time series, and demonstrates its use in factor investing, portfolio diversification, and market dynamics through simulations and financial applications.
keyPoints: CDNOTS是CD-NOD的改进版本，专门考虑时间序列数据中的滞后依赖。
研究比较了不同条件独立性检验类型和显著性水平等算法选择，给出超参数选择建议。
在模拟数据基础上，将方法应用于因子投资、组合分散和市场动态理解等金融场景。
cards.titleEn: A New Causal Discovery Method for Nonstationary Time Series
cards.originalTitle: Causal Discovery in Financial Markets: A Framework for Nonstationary Time-Series Data
cards.whyItMatters: 非平稳时间序列广泛存在于金融等领域，识别其中的因果关系有助于理解市场动态、指导因子投资与组合分散。该方法为在滞后依赖条件下进行因果结构学习提供了可操作的算法与超参数参考。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Nonstationary time series are common in finance and other fields, and identifying causal relationships can help understand market dynamics and inform factor investing and portfolio diversification. The method provides an implementable algorithm and hyperparameter reference for causal structure learning with lagged dependencies.
cards.title: 面向非平稳时间序列的因果发现新方法
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes CDNOTS, a causal structure learning method for nonstationary time series that builds on CD-NOD and specifically accounts for lagged dependencies. It compares algorithmic choices such as conditional independence tests and significance levels, offering hyperparameter guidance for different sample sizes, dimensionality, and computational resources. Using simulated data, the authors apply CDNOTS to financial settings to identify causal connections among nonstationary time series.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is based primarily on the authors' simulated data and selected financial applications, and generalizability to all data scenarios is not established; algorithm performance depends on hyperparameter choices such as the conditional independence test and significance level; robustness of causal conclusions requires independent data and external validation.

cards.summary: 论文测试14类常见日内动量信号在MNQ期货上扣除实际执行成本后是否具有可交易优势，使用2021至2025年947个交易日的五分钟数据，以扩展窗口前向验证。每类信号需同时满足样本外净收益T统计量不低于2.0、每折至少30笔交易、扣除摩擦后净收益为正、2023至2025各年方向一致、以及置换检验p小于0.001（如适用）。结果显示无一信号通过全部五项；失败分三类：11类毛收益仅0.07至1.50点，低于2.0点摩擦下限；开盘区间突破多头、VVG分类器反转和缺口延续空头虽能覆盖摩擦但存在年度不稳定或每折样本不足。两个阳性对照说明方法能检测到真实优势，但作者观点认为所测OHLCV动量信号在该品种和样本期内不存在稳健可交易边缘。
cards.limitations: 结论仅适用于MNQ期货、2021至2025年样本期、五分钟频率以及所测试的14类OHLCV信号；扩展窗口前向验证和五项标准虽降低过拟合风险，但不能排除其他频率、其他品种或其他信号构造方式存在可交易优势。两个阳性对照未在摘要中说明其数据来源和构造细节，因此不能据此推断所有OHLCV信号普遍无效。研究未提供交易策略的完整参数、滑点假设和资金管理规则，实际执行结果可能因经纪商和流动性差异而变化。
cards.description: 该研究在947个交易日的五分钟数据上，对14类基于OHLCV的日内动量信号进行扩展窗口前向验证，发现无一能同时通过五项标准；失败主要源于毛收益低于摩擦下限或年度方向不稳定。其有用性在于提供了一套可复现的证伪流程和结果边界，而非新的可交易信号。
keyPointsEn: All 14 OHLCV-based intraday momentum signal families in MNQ futures failed the five preset criteria; failures include gross returns below the 2.0-point friction floor, year-unstable direction, or insufficient trades per fold.
Two positive controls (RTH Confluence Signal out-of-sample T=3.11 and London Session Signal B out-of-sample T=4.30) indicate the falsification framework can detect genuine edge.

The study uses 947 trading days of five-minute data from 2021 to 2025, expanding-window walk-forward validation, and permutation testing (p<0.001), providing a concrete out-of-sample evaluation protocol.
cards.descriptionEn: The study applies expanding-window walk-forward validation to 14 OHLCV-based intraday momentum signal families over 947 trading days of five-minute data and finds none passes all five criteria; failures mainly stem from gross returns below the friction floor or year-unstable direction. Its value lies in a reproducible falsification protocol and stated evidence boundaries, not in a new tradable signal.
keyPoints: 14类基于OHLCV的日内动量信号在MNQ期货上均未通过五项预设标准，失败原因包括毛收益低于2.0点摩擦下限、年度方向不稳定或每折交易数不足。
两个阳性对照（RTH Confluence Signal样本外T=3.11、London Session Signal B样本外T=4.30）表明该证伪框架能够识别真实优势。
研究采用2021至2025年947个交易日五分钟数据、扩展窗口前向验证以及置换检验（p<0.001），为结果提供了具体的样本外评估流程。
cards.titleEn: Systematic Falsification of OHLCV-Based Intraday Momentum Signals in MNQ Futures
cards.originalTitle: Structural Limits of OHLCV-Based Intraday Momentum Signals in MNQ Futures: A Systematic Falsification Study
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究者而言，结果提示仅凭OHLCV构建的日内动量信号在MNQ期货上可能难以覆盖执行成本；同时，文章给出了可复用的证伪标准和阳性对照设计，有助于区分真实优势与数据挖掘噪音。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative researchers, the results suggest that intraday momentum signals built solely from OHLCV data may struggle to cover execution costs in MNQ futures; the paper also offers reusable falsification criteria and positive-control design to help distinguish genuine edge from data-mining noise.
cards.title: MNQ期货日内动量信号的系统性证伪研究
cards.summaryEn: The paper tests whether 14 common intraday momentum signals generate a tradable edge in MNQ futures after realistic execution costs, using 947 trading days of five-minute data from 2021 to 2025 under expanding-window walk-forward validation. Each signal had to simultaneously pass five criteria: out-of-sample net return T-statistic at least 2.0, at least 30 trades per out-of-sample fold, positive net returns after friction, consistent direction across 2023, 2024, and 2025, and permutation p < 0.001 where applicable. No signal passed all five; failures divide into three groups: eleven families fail because gross return before friction is 0.07 to 1.50 points, below the 2.0-point friction floor; Opening Range Breakout long, VVG classifier reversal, and gap continuation short clear friction but fail on year stability or per-fold sample minimum. Two positive controls show the method detects genuine edge, but the author's view is that the tested OHLCV momentum signals lack a robust tradable edge in this instrument and sample period.
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions apply only to MNQ futures, the 2021-2025 sample period, five-minute frequency, and the 14 tested OHLCV signal families; expanding-window walk-forward validation and the five criteria reduce overfitting risk but cannot rule out tradable edge at other frequencies, instruments, or signal constructions. The two positive controls are not detailed in the abstract in terms of data source and construction, so they do not imply that all OHLCV signals are universally ineffective. The study does not provide full strategy parameters, slippage assumptions, or money management rules, so live execution may differ across brokers and liquidity conditions.

cards.summary: 事实：GUI代理在动态界面上执行长周期任务时，固定计划容易因界面变化失效；现有技能框架多在部署前构建静态技能，未针对执行动态性设计。作者提出EvoSkill-GUI，将技能表示为包含检索元数据、可执行计划、备用定位、失败恢复规则等文件的结构化包，通过反思-修正-复用循环在部署时免训练修订技能。观点：文章认为GUI代理需要的不是更好的静态技能，而是能在部署时从执行反馈中修订的技能。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：结果基于arXiv cs.LG来源的摘要信息，尚未独立复现；增益数据来自MobileWorld、AndroidWorld和OSWorld上的特定评测设置，不能直接外推到所有GUI环境或真实生产任务。技能文件编辑依赖受限工具接口和隔离批评者设计，其鲁棒性、安全性与长期维护成本未在摘要中说明。免训练特性不排除对基座模型能力和任务分布的要求；演化技能库跨任务受益的幅度和条件也未量化。该工作不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 针对图形用户界面代理执行长周期任务时，弹出窗口、延迟加载和控件移位常使预先生成的静态技能失效的问题，EvoSkill-GUI提出无需额外训练、可在部署时根据执行反馈修订技能文件的反思-修正-复用循环。其价值在于让技能库成为随执行持续演化的程序性知识，跨模型即可提升任务表现。
keyPointsEn: EvoSkill-GUI organizes skills as multi-file structured packages containing retrieval metadata, executable plans, backup localization, failure-recovery rules, accessibility utilities, and failure cases, enabling localization and modification during execution.

The framework uses a reflect-revise-reuse loop: the executor performs instant in-rollout revisions; an isolated critic diagnoses failed trajectories under strict information isolation; and the executor edits specific skill files through a restricted tool interface.

On MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, and OSWorld, EvoSkill-GUI improves multiple base models without training, with reported maximum gains of +16.2%, +6.0%, and +10.5%, respectively, and evolved skill libraries continue to benefit related tasks.
cards.descriptionEn: To address the failure of pre-built static skills in graphical user interface agents when pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets invalidate fixed plans during long-horizon tasks, EvoSkill-GUI proposes a training-free reflect-revise-reuse loop that revises skill files from execution feedback at deployment time. Its value lies in turning the skill library into living procedural knowledge that evolves through execution and improves task performance across base models.
keyPoints: EvoSkill-GUI将技能组织为多文件结构化包，包含检索元数据、可执行计划、备用定位、失败恢复规则、可访问性工具和失败案例，以便执行时定位和修改。
框架采用反思-修正-复用循环：执行器在任务执行中进行即时修订；隔离批评者在严格信息隔离下诊断失败轨迹；执行器通过受限工具接口编辑特定技能文件。
在MobileWorld、AndroidWorld和OSWorld上，EvoSkill-GUI免训练提升多个基座模型，报告的最大增益分别为+16.2%、+6.0%和+10.5%，且演化后的技能库可继续用于相关任务。
cards.titleEn: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents via Reflect-Revise-Reuse
cards.originalTitle: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法探索了部署时免训练的技能演化路径，使GUI代理无需重新训练即可根据执行中遇到的弹出、延迟和控件移位等问题更新程序性知识；跨移动与桌面基准的评测若被复现，可降低构建可复用代理技能的工程成本，并让技能库在相关任务间迁移复用而非每次重建。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method explores a training-free path to skill evolution at deployment time, allowing GUI agents to update procedural knowledge from execution challenges such as pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets without retraining. If the cross-mobile-and-desktop benchmark results are reproduced, it could reduce the engineering cost of building reusable agent skills and allow skill libraries to transfer and be reused across related tasks rather than being rebuilt each time.
cards.title: GUI代理技能免训练演化：反思-修正-复用框架
cards.summaryEn: Fact: GUI agents executing long-horizon tasks on dynamic interfaces often see fixed plans invalidated by interface changes, while existing skill frameworks mostly build static skills before deployment rather than targeting execution dynamics. The authors propose EvoSkill-GUI, which represents each skill as a structured multi-file package containing retrieval metadata, executable plans, backup localization, failure-recovery rules, and related files, and revises skills through a reflect-revise-reuse loop without additional training. Opinion: the paper argues that GUI agents need skills that can be revised from execution feedback at deployment time, not better static skills.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: results are based on abstract information from an arXiv cs.LG source and have not been independently reproduced; the gain figures come from specific evaluation settings on MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, and OSWorld and cannot be directly extrapolated to all GUI environments or real production tasks. Skill file editing depends on a restricted tool interface and an isolated critic design, whose robustness, safety, and long-term maintenance costs are not described in the abstract. The training-free property does not rule out requirements on base model capabilities and task distribution; the magnitude and conditions under which evolved skill libraries benefit related tasks are also not quantified. This work does not constitute investment advice.

cards.summary: 大型预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽有望提升机器人可靠性，但其高推理延迟使执行时所用观测已过时，造成分布偏移并损害性能；已有异步执行方法多基于模仿学习，无法超越训练分布。本文在 EXPO-FT 基础上提出 Real-Time EXPO-FT，将大型 VLA 的动作块提议与轻量编辑策略的快速反应式修改解耦，并引入强化学习微调。作者报告在 Kinetix 基准 10/10 环境取得最佳表现，并在四项动态现实任务、在线机器人数据不超过 10 分钟条件下将平均策略性能从 42% 提升至 97%。
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在 Kinetix 基准与四项自选现实任务上的报告，尚未经独立复现；在线数据上限 10 分钟虽体现样本效率，但任务覆盖与控制条件有限；延迟与分布偏移的改善幅度、以及向其他机器人平台和更复杂任务的迁移能力仍需进一步验证；不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 针对大型预训练视觉-语言-动作模型因推理延迟导致观测过时与分布偏移的问题，提出将慢速动作生成与快速反应式动作编辑解耦，使强化学习微调满足动态现实任务的实时控制要求。
keyPointsEn: Decouples slow, expressive action generation from fast, reactive action edits, where the edit policy modifies actions based on the latest observation.
Instantiates Real-Time EXPO-FT on the EXPO-FT framework, using reinforcement learning fine-tuning to meet real-time control requirements.
Reports best performance in 10/10 Kinetix environments and an average improvement from 42% to 97% on four dynamic real-world tasks with at most 10 minutes of online data.
cards.descriptionEn: To address stale observations and distribution shift caused by high inference latency in large pretrained Vision-Language-Action models, this work decouples slow action generation from fast reactive action editing, enabling reinforcement learning fine-tuning that meets real-time control requirements for dynamic real-world tasks.
keyPoints: 将慢速、表达力强的动作生成与快速、反应式的动作编辑解耦，编辑策略基于最新观测对动作进行修改。
在 EXPO-FT 框架上实现 Real-Time EXPO-FT，用强化学习微调满足实时控制要求。
Kinetix 基准 10/10 环境最佳，四项动态现实任务平均性能由 42% 提升至 97%，在线数据上限 10 分钟。
cards.titleEn: Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies
cards.originalTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，该方法为延迟敏感的机器人部署提供了一条无需人类干预、样本高效的强化学习微调路径，有助于缩小预训练 VLA 模型与实际动态控制需求之间的差距。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, this approach offers a sample-efficient, human-intervention-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning path for latency-sensitive robot deployment, helping bridge the gap between pretrained VLA models and real-world dynamic control needs.
cards.title: 面向实时视觉-语言-动作策略的强化学习微调
cards.summaryEn: Large pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise higher robot reliability, but their high inference latency makes the observation used for action selection stale at execution time, creating distribution shift that degrades reliability and performance; prior asynchronous execution methods are mostly imitation-learning based and offer no mechanism to move beyond the training distribution. This paper builds on EXPO-FT to propose Real-Time EXPO-FT, decoupling action-chunk proposals from a large VLA and fast reactive edits by a lightweight edit policy, with reinforcement learning fine-tuning. The authors report best performance among delayed and non-delayed methods in 10 out of 10 Kinetix benchmark environments, and on four dynamic real-world tasks with online robot data capped at 10 minutes, average policy performance improves from 42% to 97%.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' reported results on the Kinetix benchmark and four self-selected real-world tasks and has not been independently reproduced; the 10-minute online data cap shows sample efficiency but covers limited tasks and control conditions; the extent of improvement in latency and distribution shift, as well as transferability to other robot platforms and more complex tasks, still requires further validation; this is not investment advice.

cards.summary: 作者指出现有偏好优化依赖 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型，难以刻画科学任务中的逻辑依赖与执行一致性。他们构建科学推理数据集，抽取推理步骤表达式、前置条件与可推导关系形成依赖图，计算执行一致性分数并附加到每个步骤，从而生成配对训练数据。微调后 Llama-3-8B 与 DeepSeekMath-7B 在 MATH 与 GSM8K 上报告了提升，并在 PhyX 多模态物理推理上报告了准确率与科学有效性结果，作者据此提出 CCPO 模型族。
cards.limitations: 证据边界应谨慎：一是数据集基于 UltraFeedback 提示构建，结论对其他领域与提示分布的泛化性未验证；二是提升幅度来自 Llama-3-8B 与 DeepSeekMath-7B 的微调实验，模型规模更大或架构不同是否同样成立未知；三是 PhyX 上的对比依赖特定评测设置，且作者报告的 50.1% 仅以微弱差距超过 DeepSeek-R1（49.8%）与 OpenAI o3-mini（48.2%），差距很小；四是科学有效性覆盖率 91.7%（alpha=0.10）与违规减少 73% 均来自作者实验，需独立复现；五是依赖图抽取质量与执行一致性分数的可靠性未给出充分错误分析。
cards.description: 现有基于 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型的偏好优化无法捕捉科学任务所需的逻辑依赖与执行一致性；该工作通过构建带依赖图的执行一致性分数并生成配对训练数据，用于语言模型对齐。
keyPointsEn: Expressions, prerequisites, and derivability relations are extracted from reasoning steps to construct dependency graphs; execution-consistency scores are computed, appended to each step, and used to create paired training data.
Fine-tuning Llama-3-8B and DeepSeekMath-7B: +17.0% on MATH and +15.1% on GSM8K.
Extending the Scientific Feasibility Control framework: 50.1% accuracy on PhyX multimodal physics reasoning, 91.7% scientific validity coverage at alpha=0.10, and 73% fewer scientific law violations.
cards.descriptionEn: Existing preference optimization methods based on Bradley-Terry reward models fail to capture the logical dependencies and execution consistency required for scientific tasks; this work constructs dependency graphs with execution-consistency scores and generates paired training data for language model alignment.
keyPoints: 从推理步骤抽取表达式、前置条件与可推导关系，构建依赖图并计算执行一致性分数，附加到每个步骤形成配对训练数据。
微调 Llama-3-8B 与 DeepSeekMath-7B：MATH 提升 17.0%，GSM8K 提升 15.1%。
扩展 Scientific Feasibility Control 框架：PhyX 多模态物理推理准确率 50.1%，科学有效性覆盖率 91.7%（alpha=0.10），科学定律违规减少 73%。
cards.titleEn: Dependency-Graph Execution-Consistency Preference Optimization Improves Language Model Scientific Reasoning
cards.originalTitle: Code Consistency Preference Optimization Verification for Language Model Alignment
cards.whyItMatters: 若该结论可复现，依赖图与执行一致性信号可为偏好优化提供超越 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型的对齐路径，尤其适用于需要逐步逻辑依赖与科学有效性的数学、物理等推理任务。但文中数据均为作者报告，尚未经独立验证，且不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the claims are reproducible, dependency graphs and execution-consistency signals may offer an alignment path beyond Bradley-Terry reward models, especially for mathematical and physical reasoning tasks that require stepwise logical dependencies and scientific validity. However, all figures are author-reported and not independently verified, and this is not investment advice.
cards.title: 依赖图执行一致性偏好优化提升语言模型科学推理
cards.summaryEn: The authors argue that existing preference optimization relying on Bradley-Terry reward models struggles to capture logical dependencies and execution consistency in scientific tasks. They build a scientific reasoning dataset, extract reasoning-step expressions, prerequisites, and derivability relations to form dependency graphs, compute execution-consistency scores, append them to each step, and create paired training data. After fine-tuning, Llama-3-8B and DeepSeekMath-7B are reported to improve on MATH and GSM8K and to achieve accuracy and scientific-validity results on PhyX multimodal physics reasoning, leading the authors to propose the CCPO model family.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries should be treated cautiously: first, the dataset is built from UltraFeedback prompts, and generalization to other domains and prompt distributions is untested; second, the reported gains come from fine-tuning Llama-3-8B and DeepSeekMath-7B, and it is unknown whether they hold for larger or differently architected models; third, the PhyX comparison depends on specific evaluation settings, and the reported 50.1% only narrowly exceeds DeepSeek-R1 (49.8%) and OpenAI o3-mini (48.2%), a small margin; fourth, the 91.7% scientific validity coverage at alpha=0.10 and the 73% reduction in violations are author-reported and require independent replication; fifth, the reliability of dependency-graph extraction and execution-consistency scoring is not supported by sufficient error analysis.

cards.summary: Hugging Face 发布视频，讨论天气预测从物理模型向神经网络模型演进，并展示其围绕研究工具与开源模型易用性的工作。事实层面，视频包含对物理模型、LLM 与预测模型关系、代码演示、Earthmovers、设备、评估及 HF 工具的讲解；观点层面，主持者认为改进工具与降低开源模型使用门槛对研究有价值。
cards.limitations: 输入仅为视频简介与时间戳，未提供模型性能、评估指标或对比结果；视频中的观点与工具效果需以实际博客与代码为准，不能据此推断预测准确率或业务适用性。
cards.description: 该内容指出神经网络模型正被用于天气预测研究，并介绍 Hugging Face 在相关工具与开源模型运行上的工作。
keyPointsEn: Weather forecasting is important, and research is moving toward neural network models
Hugging Face is interested in related research tooling and wants to improve it
The video demonstrates how to easily run an open-source weather forecasting model
cards.descriptionEn: The content notes that neural network models are being used for weather forecasting research and introduces Hugging Face's work on related tooling and running open-source models.
keyPoints: 天气预测很重要，研究正转向神经网络模型
Hugging Face 关注相关研究工具并希望改进
视频演示如何轻松运行开源天气预测模型
cards.titleEn: Hugging Face Discusses Tooling for Open-Source Weather Forecasting Models
cards.originalTitle: Can you forecast next week's weather?
cards.whyItMatters: 若开源天气预测模型更容易运行，研究者与开发者可更便捷地复现、评估和迭代相关方法，从而推动该领域工具生态的改进。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If open-source weather forecasting models are easier to run, researchers and developers can more readily reproduce, evaluate, and iterate on related methods, thereby improving the tooling ecosystem in this field.
cards.title: Hugging Face 探讨开源天气预测模型工具化
cards.summaryEn: Hugging Face released a video discussing the shift in weather forecasting from physics-based models toward neural network models, and showcasing its work on research tooling and ease of use for open-source models. Factually, the video covers physics-based models, the relationship between LLMs and forecasting models, a code walkthrough, Earthmovers, devices, evaluation, and HF tooling; as opinion, the hosts suggest that better tooling and lower barriers to open-source models are valuable for research.
cards.limitationsEn: The input is only a video description and timestamps, with no model performance, evaluation metrics, or comparison results; the views and tooling effects in the video should be judged against the actual blog and code, and cannot be used to infer forecasting accuracy or business applicability.

cards.summary: 论文介绍 Gauntlet 框架：通用编程智能体获得游戏描述、原始观察/动作接口和空策略文件后，自主实验并生成可冻结的独立控制器。作者报告：在未公开的程序化 roguelike 上留出成功率 0%–86%，并出现代际阈值；编译后的原始 API 控制器击败所有公平的《星际争霸 II》内置 AI 及两个作弊变体，单次会话程序在留出种子上以完全征服赢得《Freeciv》完整游戏。作者将这种现象称为“编译型能动性”，认为前沿编程智能体开始具备长时程策略；但此为作者对实验结果的解释与命名，尚待独立验证。
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：留出成功率范围宽且包含 0%，《文明》胜率仅‘中低’且对手为新手 AI；《星际争霸 II》与《Freeciv》结果来自作者自建评估，未公开游戏与基线；‘编译型能动性’是作者对现象的解释性概念，非独立验证的机制；没有说明跨游戏泛化、样本量、计算成本与失败模式；不构成任何投资或应用建议。
cards.description: 新在提出 Gauntlet 开发-冻结-评估框架，让通用编程智能体仅凭游戏描述与原始接口，在单次自主会话中自建独立控制器；冻结后以零模型调用在留出关卡或完整游戏中评估，首次展示编程智能体无需逐轮调用模型即可在《星际争霸 II》和《文明》中取胜。
keyPointsEn: Gauntlet uses a develop-freeze-evaluate protocol requiring the agent to build a standalone player from an empty file with no strategy, algorithm, or architecture hints, and zero model calls during evaluation.
On an unpublished procedural roguelike, held-out success spans 0–86%, and every observed session of the newest-generation system outperforms the best session of its predecessor.
The compiled raw-API controller defeats all fair StarCraft II built-in AIs and two cheating variants; single-session programs win complete Freeciv games by total conquest on held-out seeds.
cards.descriptionEn: The novelty is the Gauntlet develop-freeze-evaluate framework, where a general-purpose coding agent given only a game description and raw interface autonomously engineers a standalone controller in one session; after freezing, it is scored with zero model calls on held-out levels or full games, showing for the first time coding agents winning StarCraft II and Civilization without per-turn model calls.
keyPoints: Gauntlet 以‘开发-冻结-评估’流程，要求智能体在无策略、算法或架构提示下从空文件构建独立玩家，评估时零模型调用。
在未公开程序化 roguelike 上留出成功率 0–86%，新代际系统的每个观察会话都优于上一代最佳会话。
编译后的原始 API 控制器击败所有公平的《星际争霸 II》内置 AI 与两个作弊变体；单次会话程序在留出种子上以完全征服赢得《Freeciv》完整游戏。
cards.titleEn: Compiled Agency: Frontier Coding Agents Build Game Players from Scratch
cards.originalTitle: Compiled Agency: Frontier General-Purpose Coding Agents Build Winning Game Players from Bare Interaction - from Flappy Bird to StarCraft II and Civilization
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，意味着前沿编程智能体可将开发经验编译为持久可检查的独立执行程序，在游戏等长时程任务中减少逐轮模型调用依赖，为构建不依赖人工战术层的自主智能体提供一条可行路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the results suggest frontier coding agents can compile development experience into persistent, inspectable standalone programs, reducing reliance on per-turn model calls for long-horizon tasks like games and offering a path to autonomous agents without a hand-crafted tactical layer.
cards.title: 编译型能动性：前沿编程智能体从零自制游戏玩家
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces Gauntlet: a general-purpose coding agent receives a game description, raw observation/action interface, and an empty policy file, then autonomously experiments and produces a freezeable standalone controller. The authors report 0–86% held-out success on an unpublished procedural roguelike with a generational threshold, a compiled raw-API controller defeating all fair StarCraft II built-in AIs and two cheating variants, and single-session programs winning complete Freeciv games by total conquest on held-out seeds. The authors call this 'compiled agency' and argue frontier coding agents are beginning to track long-horizon strategy; this naming and interpretation are the authors' own and await independent verification.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is bounded: held-out success is wide and includes 0%; Civilization wins are at 'modest rates' against novice AI; StarCraft II and Freeciv results come from the authors' own evaluation with unpublished games and baselines; 'compiled agency' is the authors' explanatory concept, not an independently verified mechanism; sample sizes, compute cost, failure modes, and cross-game generalization are not detailed; not investment or application advice.

cards.summary: 作者提出深度微分网络（DDN），可同时学习Heston定价公式与模型参数偏导数。作者称，DDN估计的价格敏感度不受Heston定价函数梯度计算中常见数值问题的影响，因而适合作为快速梯度校准的定价引擎。在所选股票市场的测试中，DDN的校准精度优于非微分前馈神经网络，且计算时间远少于不使用梯度信息的全局优化器。
cards.limitations: 摘要仅称在所选股票市场上进行了广泛测试，未提供具体市场名称、数据区间、样本外验证或与全部主流校准方法的系统比较；也未说明DDN在不同参数区间、极端市场条件下的稳健性，以及训练数据覆盖范围对校准结果的影响。因此，其优势的普遍性仍需独立验证。
cards.description: 该研究提出深度微分网络（DDN），同时学习Heston模型对普通期权的定价公式及其对模型参数的偏导数，从而绕过传统Heston定价函数梯度计算中的数值问题，实现快速、准确的基于梯度的校准。在多个股票市场测试中，DDN的校准精度显著优于非微分前馈神经网络，且计算时间远少于不使用梯度信息的全局优化器。
keyPointsEn: DDN simultaneously learns the Heston pricing formula for plain-vanilla options and its partial derivatives with respect to model parameters.
DDN-estimated price sensitivities avoid numerical issues in directly computing the gradient of the Heston pricing function.
Tests show DDN outperforms non-differential feedforward neural networks in calibration accuracy and substantially reduces computational time versus gradient-free global optimizers.
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a deep differential network (DDN) that learns both the Heston pricing formula for plain-vanilla options and its partial derivatives with respect to model parameters, bypassing numerical issues in gradient computation of the Heston pricing function to enable fast, accurate gradient-based calibration. Tests on selected equity markets show that DDN significantly outperforms non-differential feedforward neural networks in calibration accuracy and dramatically
keyPoints: DDN同时学习Heston普通期权定价公式及对模型参数的偏导数。
DDN估计的价格敏感度避免了直接计算Heston定价函数梯度时的数值问题。
测试显示DDN校准精度优于非微分前馈神经网络，且比无梯度全局优化器计算时间大幅减少。
cards.titleEn: Deep Differential Networks for Heston Model Calibration: Pricing and Parameter Sensitivities
cards.originalTitle: Calibrating the Heston model with deep differential networks
cards.whyItMatters: 若DDN的精度与速度优势在更广泛场景下成立，则可为Heston模型参数校准提供一种更高效的替代方案，减少对全局优化器的依赖，并降低梯度计算中的数值风险。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If DDN's accuracy and speed advantages hold in broader settings, it could offer a more efficient alternative for Heston model calibration, reducing reliance on global optimizers and mitigating numerical risks in gradient computation.
cards.title: 深度微分网络用于Heston模型校准：兼顾定价与参数敏感度
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a deep differential network (DDN) that learns both the Heston pricing formula and its partial derivatives with respect to model parameters. They report that the price sensitivities estimated by DDN are not subject to the numerical issues often encountered in computing the gradient of the Heston pricing function, making it an excellent pricing engine for fast gradient-based calibration. In tests on selected equity markets, DDN significantly outperforms non-differential feedforward neural networks in calibration accuracy and dramatically reduces computational time relative to global optimizers that do not use gradient information.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract only states that extensive tests were conducted on selected equity markets; it does not provide specific market names, data periods, out-of-sample validation, or systematic comparisons with all mainstream calibration methods. It also does not address DDN's robustness across different parameter regimes, extreme market conditions, or how training data coverage affects calibration results. Thus, the generality of its advantages still requires independent verification.

cards.summary: 金融智能体可拆解目标、协调模型与工具并在低监督下行动，但相关治理研究不足。作者认为约束性限制不在能力而在可验证性，并将“可验证性缺口”定义为委托授权所需的验证水平与决策后保留的可解释性、可复现性之间的落差，该缺口以验证者、证据标准和审计时滞为索引。作者提出多层级治理理论，并用跨越九个模型版本、从三十亿参数本地模型到商业前沿系统的三项研究检验机制。事实层面，三项研究分别考察提供商发布对历史动作的影响、编排作为潜在策略层的作用，以及确定性信用模型版本对当前与历史动作的复现差异；作者据此主张可复现性应被视为治理剖面而非单一标量，并推出“证据依凭的委托”，即权限仅在其行使有保留证据支撑时才可辩护。
cards.limitations: 证据来自九个模型版本的三项研究，涉及本地模型、托管模型与商业前沿系统，样本范围有限，不能直接外推为所有金融场景的普遍规律。原文对“可验证性缺口”的索引方式、证据标准的具体判定，以及“证据依凭的委托”在监管中的可操作边界，均未给出完整细节。研究结论不构成投资建议，也不应被解读为对任何具体机构或模型的合规认定。
cards.description: 将金融决策权委托给智能体时，真正的治理障碍并非模型能力，而是决策后保留的可解释性与可复现性不足。本文提出“可验证性缺口”概念，并以多层级治理理论解释委托授权何时仍可辩护，对审计与合规实践有直接参考价值。
keyPointsEn: The author locates the governance bottleneck in verifiability and defines the Verifiability Gap as the shortfall between verification needed for delegated authority and evidence retained after a decision, indexed to a verifier, evidentiary standard, and audit lag.

Across three studies and nine model versions: provider releases alter historical financial actions and the controls needed for replay belong to the provider; orchestration functions as a latent policy layer shaping final actions; deterministic credit-model versions reproduce current actions but not historical ones.

The author argues reproducibility should be treated as a governance profile, not a scalar, yielding evidence-contingent delegation in which authority is defensible only while retained evidence substantiates its exercise.
The framework is said to extend to other high-stakes domains requiring auditability, but no concrete domain list or implementation path is provided.
cards.descriptionEn: When financial decisions are delegated to agentic systems, the binding governance obstacle is not model capability but the explainability and reproducibility retained after a decision. The paper defines the Verifiability Gap and offers a multilevel governance theory to explain when delegated authority remains defensible, with direct implications for audit and compliance practice.
keyPoints: 作者把治理瓶颈定位为可验证性，并用“可验证性缺口”刻画委托授权所需验证与决策后保留证据之间的落差，缺口由验证者、证据标准和审计时滞界定。
三项研究覆盖九个模型版本：提供商发布改变历史金融动作且复现所需控制属于提供商；编排作为潜在策略层影响最终动作；确定性信用模型版本能复现当前动作却难以恢复历史动作。
作者提出可复现性应作为治理剖面而非单一标量，并由此推出证据依凭的委托：权限只有在保留证据足以支撑其行使时才具可辩护性。
该框架被认为可扩展至其他需要可审计性的高风险领域，但原文未给出具体领域清单或实施路径。
cards.titleEn: The Verifiability Gap: A Core Constraint for Governing Agentic AI in FinTech
cards.whyItMatters: 若金融及高风险领域的智能体决策无法被充分复现和解释，则委托授权的合法性与事后审计都会受质疑。该框架把治理焦点从能力转向可验证证据，为设计审计要求、委托边界和问责机制提供了概念工具。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If agentic decisions in finance and other high-stakes domains cannot be sufficiently reproduced and explained, both the legitimacy of delegated authority and ex post audit are called into question. The framework shifts governance attention from capability to verifiable evidence, offering conceptual tools for designing audit requirements, delegation boundaries, and accountability mechanisms.
cards.title: 可验证性缺口：金融智能体治理的核心约束
cards.summaryEn: Financial institutions are delegating consequential decisions to agentic AI that decomposes goals, coordinates models and tools, and acts with little oversight, yet governance of such systems in FinTech is under-investigated. The author argues the binding constraint is verifiability and defines the Verifiability Gap as the shortfall between the verification delegated authority demands and the explainability and reproducibility retained after a decision, indexed to a verifier, evidentiary standard, and audit lag. A multilevel governance theory is developed and tested in three studies over nine model versions, from a three-billion-parameter local model to a commercial frontier system. As factual findings, the studies show that provider releases alter historical financial actions and that replay controls belong to the provider; that orchestration acts as a latent policy layer affecting final actions; and that deterministic credit-model versions reproduce current actions perfectly while failing to recover historical ones. The author concludes that reproducibility should be conceived as a governance profile rather than a scalar, yielding evidence-contingent delegation in which authority is defensible only while retained evidence substantiates its exercise.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from three studies over nine model versions spanning local, hosted, and commercial frontier systems, a limited sample that cannot be directly generalized to all financial settings. The original text does not provide full detail on how the Verifiability Gap is indexed, how evidentiary standards are concretely determined, or what operational regulatory boundaries evidence-contingent delegation would have. The findings are not investment advice and should not be read as a compliance determination for any specific institution or model.

cards.summary: 作者提出随机利率下的Volterra Stein-Stein模型，其中波动率和利率由相关的高斯Volterra过程驱动，统一了多个知名模型并保持解析可处理性。推导了零息债券、利率上限/下限的显式定价公式，以及对数远期指数特征函数的半显式表达。校准市场数据后，模型能捕捉利率期权平值隐含波动率的驼峰期限结构和标普500期权平值隐含波动率偏斜的凹形期限结构（对数-对数尺度）。
cards.limitations: 文中所报告的校准与经验特征仅基于作者使用的特定市场数据，未说明样本外表现或参数稳定性。模型假设波动率和利率由相关高斯Volterra过程驱动，可能无法涵盖跳跃或非高斯特征。所建立的特征函数与无限维Riccati方程的联系为理论层面，实际校准与定价效率仍依赖数值方法。
cards.description: 该研究引入随机利率下的Volterra Stein-Stein模型，将波动率与利率均建模为相关的Gaussian Volterra过程，统一了多种马尔可夫与非马尔可夫模型。其新意在于保持解析可处理性的同时，推导出零息债券、利率上下限的显式定价公式，以及基于Fredholm预解式与行列式的对数远期指数特征函数半显式表达，从而支持傅里叶方法快速定价与校准。
keyPointsEn: The model sets both volatility and interest rates as correlated Gaussian Volterra processes, unifying Markovian and non-Markovian frameworks.

It obtains explicit prices for zero-coupon bonds and interest rate caps/floors, and a semi-explicit expression for the characteristic function of the log-forward index based on Fredholm resolvents and determinants.

Calibration results show the model can reproduce the humped-shaped term structure of interest rate option implied volatilities and the concave term structure of S&P 500 option implied volatility skew.
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces the Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates, where both volatility and interest rates are driven by correlated Gaussian Volterra processes, unifying various Markovian and non-Markovian models. Its novelty lies in preserving analytical tractability while deriving explicit pricing formulas for zero-coupon bonds and interest rate caps/floors, plus a semi-explicit expression for the characteristic function of the log-forward index via Fredh
keyPoints: 模型将波动率和利率同时设为相关的高斯Volterra过程，统一了马尔可夫和非马尔可夫框架。
得到零息债券和利率上下限的显式价格，以及基于Fredholm预解式和行列式的对数远期指数特征函数半显式表达。
校准结果展示了模型可复现利率期权隐含波动率的驼峰期限结构和标普500期权隐含波动率偏斜的凹形期限结构。
cards.titleEn: Volterra Stein-Stein Model with Stochastic Interest Rates Enables Unified Modeling
cards.originalTitle: The Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架在保留解析可处理性的同时，扩展了传统线性二次模型的建模能力，为同时包含随机波动率和随机利率的衍生品定价与对冲提供了统一且计算高效的方法，有助于更灵活地拟合市场隐含波动率特征。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This framework preserves analytical tractability while extending the modeling capability of traditional linear-quadratic models, providing a unified and computationally efficient approach for pricing and hedging derivatives with both stochastic volatility and stochastic interest rates, and enabling more flexible fitting of market implied volatility features.
cards.title: 随机利率下Volterra Stein-Stein模型实现统一建模
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose the Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates, in which volatility and interest rates are driven by correlated Gaussian Volterra processes, unifying several well-known models while maintaining analytical tractability. They derive explicit pricing formulas for zero-coupon bonds, interest rate caps/floors, and a semi-explicit expression for the characteristic function of the log-forward index. Calibration to market data shows the model captures the humped-shaped term structure of ATM implied volatilities for cap options and the concave ATM implied volatility skew term structure (in log-log scale) of S&P 500 options.
cards.limitationsEn: The calibration and empirical features reported are based only on the specific market data used by the authors; out-of-sample performance and parameter stability are not addressed. The model assumes volatility and interest rates are driven by correlated Gaussian Volterra processes, which may not capture jumps or non-Gaussian features. The established connection between the characteristic function and infinite-dimensional Riccati equations is theoretical, and practical calibration and pricing still rely on numerical methods.

cards.summary: Cloudflare 在 GitHub 上发布 security-audit-skill，定位为面向编码代理的多阶段安全审计技能。其自述强调发现结果可机器读取，并经过独立验证。以上为项目自述内容，具体方法与效果需查阅仓库代码与文档确认。
cards.limitations: 目前只有项目自述信息，无法确认其审计覆盖面、误报漏报水平、验证机制细节与实测效果；不构成任何安全保证或投资建议。
cards.description: 该技能把安全审计拆成多个阶段，并让编码代理产出可机器解析且经独立验证的发现，使审计结果更易复核与纳入流程。
keyPointsEn: A security audit skill for coding agents that organizes auditing into multiple phases.
Emphasizes machine-readable findings for automated processing and review.
Claims independently verified findings, but the verification method is not described in the summary.
cards.descriptionEn: The skill splits security auditing into multiple phases and has coding agents produce machine-readable, independently verified findings, making results easier to review and integrate.
keyPoints: 面向编码代理的安全审计技能，按多个阶段组织审计流程。
强调发现结果为机器可读格式，便于自动化处理与复核。
声称发现经过独立验证，但验证方式未在摘要中说明。
cards.titleEn: Cloudflare Releases a Multi-Phase Security Audit Skill for Coding Agents
cards.whyItMatters: 安全审计结果若结构化且可验证，更便于在开发流程中复核与追踪，也让代理产出的结论更容易被人工与其他工具检查。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Structured, verifiable audit results are easier to review and track in development workflows, and make agent-produced conclusions easier for humans and other tools to check.
cards.title: Cloudflare 发布编码代理安全审计技能
cards.summaryEn: Cloudflare published security-audit-skill on GitHub as a multi-phase security audit skill for coding agents. Its description emphasizes machine-readable findings and independent verification. These are the project's own claims; methods and effectiveness require checking the repository and documentation.
cards.limitationsEn: Only the project's self-description is available; audit coverage, false-positive and false-negative rates, verification details, and measured effectiveness cannot be confirmed. This is not a security guarantee or investment advice.

cards.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库的自我定位是为 AI 编程智能体提供生产级工程技能。它出现在 GitHub Trending Daily 榜单中，说明其近期获得了一定关注。其宣称的‘生产级’属项目方的自我描述，具体技能内容需以仓库实际代码与文档为准。
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含仓库名称、一句话简介和榜单来源，未提供代码结构、技能列表、依赖或验证方式。‘生产级’为项目自我定位，尚无第三方评测或生产环境案例佐证其效果。该信息反映的是 2026 年 9 月 17 日的榜单状态，仓库内容可能已发生变化，具体能力应以实际仓库为准。
cards.description: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 上受到关注，定位是为 AI 编程智能体提供生产级工程技能，回应了智能体输出难以直接用于实际软件工程的问题，为开发者提供了可参考的技能组织思路。
keyPointsEn: The repository focuses on engineering skills for AI coding agents rather than a general agent framework.
It emphasizes a 'production-grade' orientation, pointing to code quality and engineering discipline.
It gained visibility through GitHub Trending Daily, reflecting community interest.
cards.descriptionEn: This repository is trending on GitHub and positions itself as offering production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, addressing the gap between agent demos and real software engineering while offering developers a reference for organizing agent skills.
keyPoints: 仓库定位聚焦于 AI 编程智能体的工程技能，而非通用智能体框架。
强调‘生产级’取向，指向代码质量与工程规范。
通过 GitHub Trending Daily 获得曝光，具有社区关注度。
cards.titleEn: A Production-Grade Engineering Skill Library for AI Coding Agents
cards.whyItMatters: AI 编程智能体的能力往往停留在演示层面，缺少可复用的工程实践组织方式。若该仓库确实提供了成体系的技能定义，可能帮助开发者更高效地约束和引导智能体完成实际编码任务。
cards.whyItMattersEn: AI coding agent capabilities often remain at the demo level, lacking reusable ways to organize engineering practices. If this repository indeed offers a systematic set of skill definitions, it could help developers more efficiently constrain and guide agents in real coding tasks.
cards.title: 面向 AI 编程智能体的生产级工程技能库
cards.summaryEn: The GitHub repository describes itself as providing production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents. It appeared on the GitHub Trending Daily list, indicating recent community attention. 'Production-grade' is the project's own claim; actual skills should be verified against the repository's code and documentation.
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the repository name, a one-line description, and the trending source; no code structure, skill list, dependencies, or validation methods are provided. 'Production-grade' is a self-description with no third-party evaluation or production case studies to support its effectiveness. This information reflects the trending status on September 17, 2026, and the repository's content may have changed since; actual capabilities should be based on the current repository.

cards.summary: 腾讯在 GitHub 开源了 BrowserSkill，这是一种让 AI 智能体通过 CLI 和浏览器扩展操控真实登录浏览器的方案。其设计目标是让智能体在用户继续使用浏览器的同时执行自动化任务，适用于任何支持 shell 的 AI 智能体。项目目前处于早期阶段，实际效果与兼容性需进一步验证。
cards.limitations: 当前信息仅来自 GitHub Trending 的简要描述，未包含基准测试、性能数据或安全审计结果。该项目由腾讯发布，但实际维护状态、长期支持及对各类浏览器的兼容性尚不明确。用户需自行评估在真实浏览器中授予 AI 智能体控制权的安全风险，且不应将其视为可直接用于生产环境的成熟方案。
cards.description: 该项目提供 CLI 与浏览器扩展，使 AI 智能体能在不中断用户工作的前提下操作已登录的真实浏览器，解决自动化与日常使用冲突的问题。
keyPointsEn: Combines a CLI and browser extension so AI agents can control a real logged-in browser.
Emphasizes not interrupting the user's ongoing work, unlike traditional headless browser approaches.
Compatible with any AI agent that has shell capabilities.
cards.descriptionEn: The project offers a CLI and browser extension that let AI agents operate a real, logged-in browser without interrupting the user's work, addressing the conflict between automation and daily usage.
keyPoints: 通过 CLI 与浏览器扩展组合，使 AI 智能体可操控已登录的真实浏览器。
强调不中断用户正常工作，区别于传统无头浏览器方案。
兼容任何具备 shell 能力的 AI 智能体。
cards.titleEn: Tencent Open-Sources BrowserSkill: Let AI Agents Control a Real Logged-In Browser
cards.whyItMatters: 该工具把浏览器自动化从隔离的无头环境扩展到用户真实的登录会话，可能拓展 AI 智能体在网页任务中的可用场景，例如需要登录态的操作。但项目刚开源，其稳定性、安全边界和实际适用范围仍待社区检验。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This tool extends browser automation from isolated headless environments to the user's real logged-in session, potentially expanding the usable scenarios for AI agents in web tasks, such as operations requiring login state. However, as a newly open-sourced project, its stability, security boundaries, and actual scope of applicability still need community scrutiny.
cards.title: 腾讯开源 BrowserSkill：让 AI 智能体控制真实登录浏览器
cards.summaryEn: Tencent has open-sourced BrowserSkill on GitHub, a solution that lets AI agents control a real logged-in browser via a CLI and browser extension. It aims to enable agents to perform automated tasks while the user continues using the browser, and works with any shell-capable AI agent. The project is in an early stage, and its practical effectiveness and compatibility need further verification.
cards.limitationsEn: The current information comes only from a brief GitHub Trending description; it does not include benchmarks, performance data, or security audit results. The project is released by Tencent, but its actual maintenance status, long-term support, and compatibility with various browsers remain unclear. Users should evaluate the security risks of granting AI agents control over a real browser and should not treat it as a mature solution ready for production use.
